eutrophication-chain.alt: Six linked boxes. 1: fertilizer, manure and sewage add nitrate and phosphate to a lake. 2: algae grow into a bloom. 3: the bloom blocks sunlight and algae and plants die. 4: dead matter sinks and decomposers break it down. 5: decomposers use oxygen, so dissolved oxygen falls. 6: fish die or leave, a dead zone.
